parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a sample-app path that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The other record is a production type-alias in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel). Extracting MetricRow to a common package to eliminate the duplication would couple the production DebugPanel package to sample-app demonstration semantics; the sample-app copy is intentionally self-contained. No refactor is warranted.
